te: Study visit and seminar in Nong Khai, Laos and Udon Thani prepared
se: The meeting noted the schedule of the committee's study visit and seminar in Nong Khai Province, the Lao PDR and Udon Thani Province on 25–27 April 2025, including discussions with executives of the Lao Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare and the Lao National Social Security Fund
it: Schedule of the study visit and seminar, Nong Khai Province, the Lao PDR and Udon Thani Province

se: The meeting noted an approach to advancing universal social security through the network of homes, temples and schools, village health volunteers and labour volunteers, inviting self-employed people to become insured persons under section 40

te: Report on a petition about unemployment benefits approved
se: The meeting approved the draft report on the preliminary information gathered on the petition requesting information from state agencies, independent organisations and others concerned, and proposed that the Committee on Labour end its consideration and inform the petitioner of the outcome
it: Petition requesting information from state agencies, independent organisations and others concerned

te: Report on a petition considered, and a study visit to the Social Security Office prepared
se: Agenda: consideration of the study report on the petition requesting information from state agencies, independent organisations and others concerned, and preparation of the study visit to the Social Security Office, Nonthaburi Province, on 26 March 2025
it: Petition requesting information from state agencies, independent organisations and others concerned
Preparing the study visit to the Social Security Office

te: OIC heard on risks to the Social Security Fund
se: The meeting heard a representative of the Office of Insurance Commission (OIC), who pointed out that the long-term risk to the fund is that insured persons are living longer, so financial planning must take this into account
it: Approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund

te: Actuaries heard on the sustainability of social security
se: The meeting heard a representative of the Society of Actuaries of Thailand, who pointed out that improving the social security system must take account of the changing population structure, rising medical costs and balanced fund management
it: Approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund

te: Applying ESG principles to the Social Security Fund studied
se: The meeting noted approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund with ESG principles, namely environment, society and governance; on the social side, for example, by giving priority to increasing the number of insured persons
it: Approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund with ESG principles

te: Social Security Fund data for 2020–2024 analysed
se: The meeting noted an analysis of Social Security Fund data for 2020–2024, and observed that returns can be raised both by widening the investment framework and by investments with higher returns, together with risk management by experts
it: Analysis of Social Security Fund data, 2020–2024

te: A framework set for thinking about the sustainability of the Social Security Fund
se: The meeting noted the preliminary framework of the working group studying approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund, covering matters such as risk management, sustainable investment, stakeholder participation, the use of technology and good governance
it: Approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund

te: Facts gathered on a petition about unemployment benefits
se: The meeting gathered preliminary information on the petition requesting information from state agencies, independent organisations and others concerned, under rule 77, paragraph four, of the Senate Rules of Procedure. The Social Security Office explained that the petitioner did not receive unemployment benefits because they did not report as scheduled, and that the petitioner has the right to appeal within 30 days
it: Petition requesting information from state agencies, independent organisations and others concerned

te: Approach to work adjusted while there is no House of Representatives
se: The Chair informed the meeting that while there is no House of Representatives, the draft Acts under study lapse under the Constitution, so the subcommittee has changed its approach to studying labour issues instead
it: Approach to work while there is no House of Representatives

te: Study of 2 draft labour protection laws (continued)
se: The meeting continued to study the 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives, inviting the agencies concerned to give information for its consideration
it: 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives

te: State agencies and employers heard on the draft labour protection laws
se: The meeting studied the 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives, inviting the Ministry of Labour, the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security, the Ministry of Public Health and employers' organisations to give information
it: 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives

te: Substance of 2 draft labour protection laws studied
se: The meeting studied the substance of the 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives, such as working hours of no more than 40 hours a week, 2 weekly days off, 10 days of annual leave, the right to leave to care for family members, and breastfeeding spaces at work
it: 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives

te: Civil society heard on 2 draft labour protection laws
se: The meeting heard the Ministry of Labour, the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security and civil society organisations, which support the 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives
it: 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives

te: Small working groups set up to study 2 draft labour protection laws
se: The meeting approved setting up 2 small working groups, one for each draft, to study the 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives, and planned 4 sessions to invite state agencies, employees' organisations and labour and women's foundations to give information
it: 2 draft Labour Protection Acts (No. ..) B.E. .... accepted in principle by the House of Representatives
